"We can't keep redistributing money to Ukraine or to some billion-euro Brazilian rainforest fund. It seems there's enough money for everyone, everywhere, for every country and for NGOs, but not for our own citizens. Not for pensioners, not for taxpayers, not for those paying into social security.
